nodes.klein: to move to and fro, wander. he moved to and fro, wandered aimlessly; it fluttered (said of a bird); he wavered, shook; he showed grief (by shaking or nodding the head), lamented; he condoled. he made mobile, mobilized. was made mobile, was mobilized. he moved himself to and fro, swayed, tottered; 22 he bemoaned himself. he caused to wander; he wagged the head. was shaken; was tossed.
